action.sql: SELECT SUM(g.debit - g.credit) AS operating_expenses_ytd FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = g.account_id WHERE g.entity_id = 'US01' AND g.dept_id = 'ENG' AND g.period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-05' AND a.type = 'Expense' AND CAST(g.account_id AS INTEGER) > 6000 AND CAST(g.account_id AS INTEGER) < 7000
